description: React component 'UsersList' that displays a list of users with filtering options including search, tenant, and date range. It fetches data from an API, manages local state, and renders a data table with optional delete actions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches user data from the API with optional startDate and endDate filters, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters and reloads the user data.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Handles click events on user rows, invoking callback functions if provided.
